notes.title: Mission briefing: Ocean-I’s sunken ambitions
notes.content:
Agents, before you descend, context is vital: you must understand the waters you enter.



The Pacific is vast: half the planet’s waters gathered in a single abyss. And yet, even now, more than eighty percent of its floor remains untouched, unseen, unmeasured. The deepest trench falls farther than Everest rises, but still it is only a fragment of the whole. Every descent uncovers life unclassified, shapes no taxonomy can contain… and still there are regions we cannot reach. In 2053, humanity turns its gaze downward, driven by hunger for resources. They believe the ocean is empty space to be claimed.



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45528910/4312c0dfb98192fb2ff24c6eb2a00d3f24d5a538.png"]



Behind this new age of deep exploration stands Ocean-I, the brainchild of Andrew Marsh, a tech magnate turned oceanic industrialist. Ocean-I’s vision was clear: conquer the abyss and extract “white hydrogen,” a rare energy source believed to lie beneath the oceanic crust.

To achieve this, Marsh and his investors built a network of submarine stations, fortified outposts at the edge of human engineering. Ocean-I was not simply a corporation; it became an empire beneath the waves, drawing capital from American fortunes and powerful backers across the globe. Its promise was prosperity. Its ambition limitless.

But ambition has a cost.



At the time, this article from the Arkham Adviser passed as routine business news. Now, with hindsight, it reads differently. Study the words. The gaps between them matter most:

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45528910/6f50de619cb21a3d3ab7e15fec22e8bd4390a0a0.png"]

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45528910/79e78f9c66152ef3017d1becaee09b9969555f3c.png"]



Officially, Ocean-I cites seismic instability. But those who walked the corridors of PIT Station speak differently.

Now, as agents, we are called to look closer. Another site, another silence. Miners gone missing. A labyrinth of drowned structures waiting for answers.

And in the static between signals… something may stir.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45528910/40d55164eba710005aecc6c3bc6d4a9fdfa17ee7.png"]

notes.title: Important Message - Code name: Playtest
notes.content:
ANCILE ALERT – CALLING ALL AGENTS
The signals have stabilized - if only briefly. Whatever lies beneath is no longer dormant. It’s reaching. Responding… And we don’t ignore the Abyss when it speaks.

On July 10th, we begin our first live descent into the echo field.
Code name: Playtests.
A limited window. A first contact. A test - though you and I know better than to call it that.

I’ve arranged clearance for trusted Ancile agents to enter early. That could be you.


REGISTER NOW:
Access to the operation is being managed through Steam.

👉 Go to the MyNacon website

👉 Create your account

👉 Click “Register”

If you’re selected, you will receive a NDA form to complete (All findings remain buried).

You must be registered before July 1st. Not all will be granted immediate entry - signals are staggered. If you receive an invitation, act fast.


FIELD TEST BRIEF:
This is an unstable signal. Expect corruption. Expect gaps. Expect truth.

Your goal: Explore, observe, report. Nothing you see is irrelevant.

Every detail, every breach, every whisper: log it.

Watch your perception. And welcome to the first descent.

notes.title: Welcome, Ancile Agents
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45528910/33b4e1ab085b9cf8a4ca7bca2465e1978817a66e.gif

Welcome to Ancile, agent. We are an international organization that investigate the occult.

I’m Key, your new AI companion, and I’m excited to bring you an update on something truly unsettling. Big Bad Wolf, the minds behind The Council and Vampire: The Masquerade - Swansong, have just unveiled their latest creation, Cthulhu: The Cosmic Abyss. Brace yourselves for an experience like no other — an immersive dread thriller that will test the limits of your sanity.

[previewyoutube=ThN3eSfWqUo;full][/previewyoutube]
About Cthulhu: The Cosmic Abyss:

“Ph'nglui mglw'nafh Cthulhu R'lyeh wgah'nagl fhtag.” — In his house at R'lyeh, dead Cthulhu waits dreaming.

In this Lovecraftian-inspired investigation game, you’ll step into the shoes of Noah, an agent tasked with unraveling the mystery of a group of miners who vanished deep beneath the Pacific Ocean. As you dig into the strange disappearance, the creeping darkness will test not only your investigative skills but your grip on reality. Can you resist the madness?

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45528910/6aeaf82386041bb1e421df523fbeeeba81f48b97.png
About Big Bad Wolf:

Here’s an audio transcription from the studio: “We are a French studio based in Bordeaux, renowned for our narrative-driven games that feature distinctive art styles. Our focus is on crafting deep, story-rich experiences that blend mystery, psychological intrigue, and player-driven choices. The worlds we build encourage exploration and emphasize character-driven narratives, with immersive, often eerie storytelling”

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45528910/7175373a472ecd095a7f91e85b252ac6900e0df9.png

Let’s Stay Connected:

We’re just getting started, and I’ll be sure to share more details as they unfold. In the meantime, we invite you to join our official Discord server to discuss the game, theories, and more.

Discord

And while you’re waiting for your next descent into madness, be sure to Wishlist Cthulhu: The Cosmic Abyss on Steam now: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2760560/Cthulhu_The_Cosmic_Abyss/
